verdict.rationale: LathamDrive documents a first-party legal document generator that lets entrepreneurs create incorporation documents. It also documents an Automated Convertible Note generator with customizable market-standard terms, so the firm ships its own document-generation tooling beyond static templates. However, the evidence does not describe the interactive online assembly flow, how self-serve it is, or what output it produces, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: documented interactive questionnaire or online completion workflow, scope of documents covered beyond incorporation and convertible notes, independent or hands-on confirmation the tools are live and usable.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm ships self-serve document automation — interactive assembly of real legal documents I can complete online, not just static templates

citations.quote: Legal document generator allows entrepreneurs to create the documents necessary to incorporate a company.
an OpenLaw-based document generator that helps startups raise capital with customizable market standard terms and optional digital token provisions
